LIT Virtual Audio Cable - G2 x64 Debug package
================================================

Contents
--------
This archive contains the complete componentized SysVAD test package.
Do not copy only the SYS/INF/CAT files: the INF component graph also uses the
included APO and keyword-detector DLL files.

Device hardware ID
------------------
Root\LIT_VirtualAudioCable

Expected endpoints after a successful test installation
--------------------------------------------------------
LIT Virtual Cable Input  (render/playback)
LIT Virtual Cable Output (capture/recording)

Important
---------
This is a WDK test-signed hackathon build, not a production-signed driver.
Normal Secure Boot policy will reject it with Device Manager Code 52.

Package identity
----------------
Kernel binary: LITVirtualAudioCable.sys
Catalog:       litvirtualaudiocable.cat
Service:       lit_virtual_audio_cable
APO component: SWC\VEN_LITH&CID_VADAPO

Source branch: driver/mvp-cable
